jobs_to_be_done.text: When I glance at the terminal, I want to know whether the fleet is alive and how complete and fresh my view is, so that I do not mistake a partial or stale picture for the whole fleet.
When I come back after a while, I want to see what changed since I last looked, so that I find meaningful updates without rereading chat.
When one worker row matters, I want to inspect its full evidence with full identifiers, so that I judge it on facts, not on activity.
When I need to share or archive what I saw, I want a plain-text export of exactly the view on screen.
jobs_to_be_done.flag: handoff M12: JTBD-4 "exactly the view on screen" vs CAP-9/T48 lossless export (handoff-step2.md:24)

jobs_to_be_done.text: When agents ask humans questions, I want every observed open question kept until explicit closure evidence, so that reading is never treated as handling.
When I decide one question, I want to see who is affected and the evidence, so that I answer with the right scope.

As a human supervising orchestrators, I want a read-only view of attention, affected work, changes, and evidence, so that I can find decisions and inspect their supporting facts without confusing activity with outcomes.

journeys.name: Fleet glance (R1)
steps: 2. The header shows scope, collected versus reported counts, freshness, and the notice that human questions are not observed.
3. The COUNTS strip shows source state counts unsummed.
4. If data is partial or stale the header says so in words.

journeys.name: What changed (R1)
steps: 1. The supervisor presses `m` to mark a look.
2. On the next cycle, rows whose stage, `nextAction.kind` or `liveness.verdict` changed are starred and counted;
3. rows no longer read show `not reobserved`.

journeys.name: Inspect (R1)
steps: 1. The supervisor selects a row; selection follows the row's identity across reorders.
2. Enter opens the inspector with every identifier in full or `unknown (absent in source)`.

journeys.name: Export (R1, any platform)
steps: 1. The supervisor presses `e` or runs with `--once`
2. and gets a plain-text record of the same view: no escape bytes, full IDs.

journeys.name: Find the oldest question (R2/R3, gated)
steps: 1. "find the oldest question and inspect its evidence" (merged requirements, C's walkthrough task).

journeys.name: DIRECTION-SELECTED review task
steps: 1. reviewed against synthetic R0 renders of A, B, C at 160/116/80, each beside its degraded state,
2. with the task "find the oldest question and inspect its evidence".

functional_reqs_ux.text: STALE after 45 s without a successful read on a monotonic clock; back-off caps at 60 s; `FAILED (timeout)`; poll age and evidence age show separately; four fact states `known`, `unknown`, `unavailable`, `stale`.

`n+? (k unknown)`, never a clean `n`; COUNTS strip shows numbers and denominators only, no bars, no health name, at 80, 116 and 160 columns; its priority tokens are never truncated (T35). Source state counts are never summed.

Report, acceptance, tests and approval each render `unavailable (no source)` in live mode; SETTLED and POLICY FROZEN render `unavailable (no source)`, never blank or zero; `terminalState=released` with no `outcome` never renders `done`, `complete` or `settled`.

Cost renders `cost unavailable`, never `$0`; elapsed time never shown as completion percentage; policy-frozen work stays visible, never auto-cleared; dirty worktree not shown as dangerous, stale not shown as failed, shared paths not shown as a conflict, inspectable evidence not shown as admission.
